"I just graduated college with no job and no job prospects."

Here's a newsflash for you.... I'm a 52 year old JUNIOR High-school DROP-OUT who owns his own business and is quite successful with it. EVERYTHING I learned that I needed for life was taught to me by the time I was in 6th grade.

I learned math (not common-core math - REAL math). I learned how to read and write. I learned basic science. I learned American history. I learned grammar. I learned music. But, most importantly, I learned between 7th and 8th grade that the remainder of the schooling would be nothing more than daycare for older children. One other thing I learned... knowledge is free! Becoming smart is free! And I don't need (and no one needs) someone to teach them WHAT to think.

This is what the parents are allowing. This is what these uninformed, uneducated, know-it-all (yet, know nothing) kids are signing up for! MASSIVE debt from a worthless degree just so they can call themselves "educated".

A lot of people bought into the idea that "everyone should have access to college". And the government started subsidizing student loans and handing out more grants.
